mLocKeys.keySummary: Janna conjures a defensive gale that shields an ally champion or turret from incoming damage and increases their Attack Damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Janna grants an ally champion or turret @TotalShield@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. While shielded, they gain @TotalAD@ Attack Damage.

Janna refunds @ECDRefundforCC*100@% of the cooldown whenever she impairs an enemy champion's movement with an Ability.
This unit has increased healing and shielding.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Eye of the Storm</titleLeft><mainText>Absorbs damage taken and grants the unit bonus Attack Damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: By creating a localized change in pressure and temperature, Janna is able to create a small storm that grows in size with time. She can activate the spell again to release the storm. On release this storm will fly towards the direction it was cast in, dealing damage and knocking away any enemies in its path.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Janna summons a tornado that grows stronger over @MaxDuration@ seconds then blows along its path. It deals <magicDamage>@MinimumDamage@ - @MaxDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Knocks Up</status> for @BaseKnockup@ - @MaxKnockup@ seconds. The distance, damage, and <status>Knock Up</status> duration increase based on how much the tornado grew. Janna can <recast>Recast</recast> to send the tornado early.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Deals an additional <magicDamage>@ExtraDamagePerSecondCharged@ magic damage</magicDamage>, <status>Knocks Up</status> for an additional @ChargeKnockup@ seconds, and travels @ChargeDistancePercent@% farther for each second it grew, and always reaches its destination in @MissileTravelTime@ seconds.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Howling Gale</titleLeft><mainText>Janna can activate Howling Gale to release her whirlwind.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Janna surrounds herself in a magical storm, throwing enemies back. After the storm has settled, soothing winds heal nearby allies while the ability is active.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Janna summons a magical monsoon, <status>Knocking Back</status> nearby enemies then healing nearby allies for <healing>@TotalHeal@ Health</healing> over @Effect3Amount@ seconds. Moving or using an Ability ends the monsoon early.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>The <status>Knock Back</status> cannot push enemies over walls.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Monsoon</titleLeft> <mainText>Janna has conjured a magical storm, healing nearby allies every second.</mainText> <postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Janna summons an air elemental that passively increases her Move Speed and enables her to pass through units. She may also activate this ability to deal damage and slow an enemy's Move Speed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Janna gains @TotalMS@ Move Speed and is Ghosted.

Active: Janna's elemental strikes an enemy, Slowing them by @TotalSlow@ for @SlowDuration@ seconds, and dealing @TotalDamage@ + @spell.TailwindSelf:BonusDamage@ magic damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: Ghosted units ignore collision with other units.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Zephyr</titleLeft><mainText>Janna's Move Speed is increased, and she is able to move through units.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

Ally champions gain @MSPercentAlly*100@% Move Speed moving towards Janna.

Janna deals @BonusDamage@ bonus magic damage {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }} and with Zephyr.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Janna's allies gain Move Speed moving towards her.

Janna deals a portion of bonus Move Speed as bonus magic damage on hit and with Zephyr.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Ally champions gain @MSPercentAlly*100@% Move Speed moving towards Janna.

Janna deals @BonusDamage@ bonus magic damage {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }} and with Zephyr.
